findings.description: New registered classes LensedMarginalizedExtrinsicIASPrior and LensedMarginalizedExtrinsicLikelihood exist in code and prior_registry (verified: registered, default_likelihood_class wired, 19 standard_params = 12 intrinsic + 7 lens, no extrinsic), but SPEC.md's 'Microlensed sampling layer' and likelihood rows still name only LensedIASPrior and LensedRelativeBinningLikelihood. git diff confirms SPEC.md and DATA_CONTRACTS.yaml are unchanged this build though SPEC.md was in the plan's expected-changes list. Artifact->spec divergence. This is a documentation-sync item (Librarian-owned, reserved for commit-time per acceptance criteria), NOT a code defect — code and tests are correct and green.
